findings.title: schedule_blocker counts K08/K06 summary calls as unreviewed external outcomes
findings.state: confirmed by code read at base 0793f254 + existing e2e workaround + 42cf2e98 recorded failures; NOT implemented
mechanism: application/background_review.py:147-156 reserve_call(..., purpose='summary') tied to the reviewed run_id

adapters/persistence/lease_repository.py:120-155 specs model_calls (reserved/unknown) + actions (executing/unknown) + outbox (unknown); model_calls has no purpose filter; only schedule_reviews exact acknowledgment excludes a row

adapters/persistence/lease_repository.py:99-105 assert_run_lease raises previous_outcome_unknown; schedule_repository.py:477-483 materialize sets error previous_outcome_unknown and does not materialize the next occurrence or advance next_at
application/context.py:151/289 run compaction also reserves purpose='summary' calls under the same run, so a crash leaves the same block
test_v2_cronjob_e2e.py:61-78 wait_review_settled documents the interaction and waits for the review batch to leave queued/running before triggering
findings.impact: short-interval/back-to-back schedules whose previous occurrence's post-turn review is in flight terminally fail the next occurrence (previous_outcome_unknown) and retry-fail each tick until the review settles; a crashed review leaves an unknown summary call that blocks until owner manual review; no external action is replayed
findings.decision: docs/v2/contracts/V2_SCHEDULE_REVIEW_BLOCKER.md (options A-D; recommended A: blocker counts only purpose='turn')
